build_modified_resnet_model: build a ModifiedResNet model with specified layers, output_dim, and attention heads for image feature extraction
create_bottleneck_block: create a Bottleneck residual block with configurable inplanes, planes, and stride for ResNet construction
create_attention_pool2d: create an AttentionPool2d module that applies multi-head self-attention with a CLS token to spatial features
lock_resnet_parameters: lock all ModifiedResNet parameters and optionally freeze batch norm statistics for inference or fine-tuning
run_resnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ModifiedResNet model to extract image features via stem, layers, and attention pool
